```yaml
name: Triage Issue

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install regex

      - name: Triage issue
        id: triage
        run: |
          import re
          from github import Github

          g = Github()
          issue = g.get_repo('thepagent/claw-info').get_issue(${{ github.event.issue.number }})

          title = issue.title.lower()
          body = issue.body.lower() if issue.body else ''

          labels = []

          # Determine issue type
          if re.search(r'\b(bug|error|crash|broken|fix|fail|wrong|regression)\b', title + ' ' + body):
              labels.append('bug')
          elif re.search(r'\b(feat|feature|enhancement|add|implement|request|improve)\b', title + ' ' + body):
              labels.append('feature-request')

          # Determine priority
          if re.search(r'\b(critical|urgent|blocker|blocking|severe|p0|p1)\b', title + ' ' + body):
              labels.append('priority: high')
          elif re.search(r'\b(minor|trivial|nice to have|low priority|p3|p4)\b', title + ' ' + body):
              labels.append('priority: low')
          else:
              labels.append('priority: medium')

          # Add labels to issue
          issue.add_to_labels(*labels)

          echo "::set-output name=labels::" + ','.join(labels)
```
